description: Two-column hero with copy on the left and a product window mockup on the right. Strongest fit when there is a real screenshot, demo gif, or hero illustration to anchor the visual.

brand.hint: Eyebrow line above the headline. 1-3 words. Usually the product or company name. Omit if the page is a sub-page of a known brand.

title.hint: 6-12 words. Lead with the outcome the customer gets, not the product name. Avoid superlatives ('best', 'amazing').

subtitle.hint: 1-2 sentences, 15-30 words. Explain who it's for and the single differentiator.

primaryCta.hint: Primary action (signup, demo, contact). Verb-first text, 1-3 words.

secondaryCta.hint: Lower-commitment action (learn more, watch demo, read docs).

image.hint: Product screenshot, demo gif, or hero illustration. Rendered inside a browser-window chrome — works best with rectangular UI imagery, not square or portrait.

preview.title: Ship your marketing site in an afternoon.
preview.subtitle: Pick a blueprint, describe what you want, and walk away with a real Astro build — themed, responsive, and ready to deploy.
